subject: tips for your driving test
author: Lofty_1783
body:
Don't drift
Takedowns are NOT allowed unless the car you're aiming at has yellow and blue squares on it
The handbrake is NOT used for turning
Don't waste time looking for boost, your learner car is unlikely to have this feature
BILLBOARDS ARE NOT TARGETS
Ramps are NOT your friend
At least TRY to stay out of oncoming (in addition to this please note that in this country, we drive on the LEFT)

Good luck Zombietron, hope your test isn't cancelled because of the snow!
